verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Ledgy. 'Automate your granting, document and signature workflows in bulk' describes one-off bulk actions, not a recurring schedule. Vesting schedules are an equity concept rather than job scheduling, and the incremental API pagination is only a building block a user could drive from their own external scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
